text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Compare gross order revenue (order total) per location this year versus last year with the absolute change and order counts, so the locations where revenue is down are visible; causal drivers and an investment recommendation are not held by the project.","measures":[{"ref":"metric:orders.order_total","alias":"revenue_last_year","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["last_year"],"source":"question"}]},{"ref":"metric:orders.order_total","alias":"revenue_this_year","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["this_year"],"source":"question"}]},{"change":{"base":"revenue_last_year","comparison":"revenue_this_year","as":"absolute"},"alias":"revenue_change"},{"ref":"metric:orders.orders","alias":"orders_last_year","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["last_year"],"source":"question"}]},{"ref":"metric:orders.orders","alias":"orders_this_year","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["this_year"],"source":"question"}]}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"entity:orders.location","role":"key"}],"display":["dimension:locations.location_name"],"filters":[],"ordering":{"ref":"revenue_change","direction":"asc"},"expectedShape":"comparison","unresolved":[{"clause":"why is our revenue down","options":[],"material":true,"question":"The project holds revenue and order counts by location and period but no causal drivers; the comparison shown is this year versus last year per location."},{"clause":"which region should we invest in","options":[],"material":true,"question":"An investment recommendation is not a governed measure; the per-location revenue change is provided for you to judge."}],"provenance":{"metric:orders.order_total":"q:revenue","metric:orders.orders":"q:revenue down","entity:orders.location":"q:by region","dimension:locations.location_name":"q:by region","dimension:orders.ordered_at":"q:revenue down"}}
